context: Registered after the A1 uniform lower-bound failure; a separate positive-system theorem, not evidence for A1.
hypotheses: The componentwise supersolution bounds every generated sector-bounded trajectory.
The maximal positive linear zero-memory instance approaches the bound.
data: New seeded random finite-dimensional instances generated only after this spec is pushed; no market data.
dates: Generation after verified remote registration; not a historical empirical sample.
primary: Every case passes both componentwise enclosure and linear sharpness tolerance. Any violation fails the primary.
correction: One joint primary; no multiple-testing claims or population p-values.
design: Dimensions uniform integers 2..5; cohorts 1..4; nonnegative dense A,K,Qbar and diagonal sector vectors; rescale to rho in [0.2,0.9], then positive diagonal similarity exp([-2,2]). Time-varying gains between zero and Qbar; tanh sector responses; bounded independent shocks; diagonal memory in [0,0.995]. Save generated matrices and primary diagnostics.
pass_rule: All 128 cases meet rho<1, nonnegative supersolution (tolerance), normalized enclosure violation <=1e-10 and normalized linear sharpness residual <=1e-8.
opening_rule: Advance zero counter before generation; never rerun an opened test; retain failed outcomes. Changed designs require a new explicitly post-failure registration.
